record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace raw GRU-state readout with causal recency pooling: normalized weights 0.8^(t-j) over nonpadding positions j<=t. Apply at every supervised position and read the final real pooled position at inference. Prior gains motivate testing this readout with the incumbent mixed loss. Preserve history truncation, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer; keep predictor behavior consistent.
